candidate_windows.window_text: Prior to engaging in multimodal structural knowledge learning, a warm-up stage is implemented to facilitate the models' acquisition of fundamental code syntax structures and visual concepts with their definitions. To accomplish this, we integrate code training data (Kocetkov et al., 2022), code-formulated class definitions of WordNet and FrameNet synsets, and all datasets within the ViStruct Suite, then subject the models to a single training epoch.
